parts.title: ตอนที่ 1: อ่านย่อหน้าแล้วตอบคำถาม (12 ข้อ)
parts.instructions: Somchai works at a small shop in the market. The shop sells fruit and vegetables. It opens at 7 AM and closes at 6 PM every day except Sunday. Many people come to buy fresh fruit from Somchai because his prices are cheap and his fruit is always fresh. Somchai's favorite fruit is mango. He says mango is delicious and good for health. Every morning, he goes to the farm to buy fresh fruit before opening his shop. His daughter sometimes helps him at the shop after school.
items: What is the passage mainly about? (ก. A school ข. Somchai's shop ค. A hospital ง. A bus station)
What does Somchai's shop sell? (ก. Books ข. Clothes ค. Fruit and vegetables ง. Toys)
What time does the shop open? (ก. 6 AM ข. 7 AM ค. 8 AM ง. 9 AM)
What time does the shop close? (ก. 5 PM ข. 6 PM ค. 7 PM ง. 8 PM)
Which day is the shop closed? (ก. Saturday ข. Monday ค. Sunday ง. Friday)
Why do many people buy fruit from Somchai? (ก. Because it's far ข. Because his prices are cheap and fruit is fresh ค. Because he is famous ง. Because the shop is big)
What is Somchai's favorite fruit? (ก. Apple ข. Banana ค. Mango ง. Orange)
The word "delicious" is closest in meaning to...? (ก. expensive ข. tasty ค. cheap ง. fresh)
Where does Somchai go every morning before opening his shop? (ก. School ข. The farm ค. The bank ง. The hospital)
What can we infer about Somchai? (ก. He is lazy ข. He is careful about his business ค. He dislikes his job ง. He never works)
The word "He" in "He says mango is delicious" refers to...? (ก. the shop ข. Somchai ค. the farm ง. the daughter)
Who sometimes helps Somchai at the shop? (ก. His wife ข. His daughter ค. His son ง. His friend)
reasons: ทั้งย่อหน้าพูดถึงร้านของสมชาย

parts.title: ตอนที่ 2: อ่านย่อหน้าแล้วตอบคำถาม (12 ข้อ)
parts.instructions: Ploy loves reading books. Every weekend, she goes to the library near her house. The library is big and quiet. Ploy usually reads storybooks and comic books. Her favorite book is about a young girl who travels to different countries. Ploy dreams of traveling around the world one day, just like the girl in her favorite book. Ploy's best friend, Nam, also loves reading, so they often go to the library together and share their favorite stories.
items: What does Ploy love doing? (ก. Swimming ข. Reading books ค. Cooking ง. Singing)
Where does Ploy go every weekend? (ก. The market ข. The library ค. The zoo ง. The park)
How is the library? (ก. Small and noisy ข. Big and quiet ค. Old and dirty ง. Far and expensive)
What kind of books does Ploy usually read? (ก. Science books ข. Storybooks and comic books ค. Cook books ง. Math books)
What is Ploy's favorite book about? (ก. A boy who plays football ข. A girl who travels to different countries ค. A dog and a cat ง. A teacher)
What does Ploy dream of doing? (ก. Becoming a teacher ข. Traveling around the world ค. Opening a library ง. Writing a book)
The word "quiet" is closest in meaning to...? (ก. noisy ข. silent ค. big ง. small)
The word "her" in "Her favorite book" refers to...? (ก. the library ข. Ploy ค. the girl in the book ง. the world)
What can we infer about Ploy? (ก. She dislikes books ข. She is inspired by the book she reads ค. She never goes out ง. She hates traveling)
This passage is mainly about...? (ก. A library's rules ข. Ploy's love of reading and her dream ค. How to travel the world ง. A comic book store)
Who is Ploy's best friend? (ก. Nid ข. Nam ค. Ann ง. Ben)
The word "they" in "they often go to the library together" refers to...? (ก. Ploy and Nam ข. Ploy and the girl in the book ค. the books ง. the library)

passages.title: 📖 ย่อหน้าที่ 1: Tum and Football
passages.text: Tum is a Grade 9 student who loves playing football. Every afternoon after school, he practices with his friends at the field near his house. His coach says Tum is very talented and works harder than anyone else on the team. Last month, Tum's team won the district championship, and he scored the winning goal in the final match. Tum dreams of becoming a professional football player one day. He always tells his friends, "If you practice every day, you will improve." Tum's parents are proud of him and support his dream by driving him to practice every day.

passages.title: 📖 ย่อหน้าที่ 2: Kate's Baking Day
passages.text: Kate is spending her Saturday afternoon baking cookies with her mother. Her mother is teaching her a family recipe that has been passed down for three generations. Kate carefully measures the flour and sugar, just like her mother shows her. Halfway through, Kate forgets to add the eggs, so the mixture looks strange and dry. Her mother laughs gently and helps her fix the mistake. After an hour, they take a tray of golden brown cookies out of the oven. The whole kitchen smells sweet. Kate feels proud because this is the first time she has baked something all by herself.

passages.title: 📖 ย่อหน้าที่ 3: A Family Trip to the Beach
passages.text: Last weekend, the Suksawat family drove three hours to spend the day at a quiet beach in the south. The children built sandcastles while their parents set up a small tent for shade. Around noon, they ate lunch together on a large mat near the water. In the afternoon, the wind became strong and the waves grew bigger, so the lifeguard asked everyone to stay closer to the shore. Despite the wind, the family enjoyed watching the sunset before driving home. They all agreed it was one of the best trips they had taken together.

passages.title: 📖 ย่อหน้าที่ 4: Nan's Part-Time Job
passages.text: Nan works part-time at a small bookstore near her school every weekend. Her main duties are arranging books on the shelves and helping customers find what they are looking for. At first, Nan found the job difficult because she had to remember where hundreds of books were kept. After a few weeks, however, she became familiar with the store and could answer customers' questions quickly. The bookstore owner often praises her for being responsible and polite to every customer. Nan uses the money she earns to buy books for herself and save for university in the future.

passages.title: 📖 ย่อหน้าที่ 5: Reducing Plastic Waste
passages.text: Many schools in Thailand have started programs to reduce plastic waste. Students are encouraged to bring their own bottles and food containers instead of using single-use plastic. One school in Chiang Mai reported that plastic waste decreased by half within just one semester after starting this program. Teachers explain that small daily choices, like refusing a plastic straw, can make a big difference over time. Some students were unsure about the change at first, but most of them now say they feel proud to be part of protecting the environment. The school plans to expand the program to include recycling stations next year.
